item_short_desc: Stay protected from pesky insects during outdoor activities with Rothco’s Mosquito Head Net. Constructed from fine mesh netting, this head covering blocks mosquitoes, gnats, and other bugs without obstructing your vision. The elastic neck cord ensures a snug, secure fit, preventing insects from slipping through. Lightweight and versatile, the net can be worn over hats, such as boonie hats, for added convenience. Whether you’re camping, hiking, or fishing, this mosquito net provides essential protection.
